dataset: Synthetic 1280x768 Windows-like screens (wallpaper, taskbar, Explorer, dense console text) with a scrolled/moved second state per screen; RDP8 v6 caches with cache-hit deduplication and newest-first record order. Accuracy on real caches is not established by this result.
gui_measurement: Offscreen Qt event-loop heartbeat; not a GPU/display frame-rate guarantee
